tools.name: get_vision_items
tools.description: Query Compose tracker items. Filter by phase, status, type, or keyword. Returns id, title, type, phase, status, confidence, description.

phase.description: Filter by phase: vision, requirements, design, planning, implementation, verification, release

status.description: Filter by status (comma-separated for multiple): planned, in_progress, complete, blocked, parked, killed

type.description: Filter by type: task, decision, evaluation, idea, spec, thread, artifact, question, feature, track

keyword.description: Search keyword matched against title and description

tools.name: get_item_detail
tools.description: Get full detail for a single tracker item including all its connections.

tools.name: get_phase_summary
tools.description: Get status and type distribution for a phase (or all phases). Useful for understanding overall project health.

phase.description: Phase to summarize: vision, requirements, design, planning, implementation, verification, release. Omit for all phases.

tools.name: get_blocked_items
tools.description: List all tracker items that are blocked by non-complete items.

tools.name: get_current_session
tools.description: Get the most recent session: tool count, items touched, error count, and recent Haiku summaries of what was accomplished.

featureCode.description: Optional: get context for a specific feature

tools.name: bind_session
tools.description: Bind the current agent session to a lifecycle feature. Call once per session after creating/identifying the feature. Binding is one-shot — calling again on a bound session returns already_bound.

tools.name: set_workspace
tools.description: Bind this MCP session to a workspace. Required when cwd contains multiple workspaces. Lives in process memory; lost on MCP restart.

tools.name: get_workspace
tools.description: Get the current MCP workspace binding plus all candidates discovered from cwd.

tools.name: get_feature_lifecycle
tools.description: Get the lifecycle state of a feature: current phase, phase history, artifacts, warnings.

tools.name: kill_feature
tools.description: Kill a feature from any phase. Records reason and sets status to killed.

reason.description: Why the feature is being killed

tools.name: complete_feature
tools.description: Mark a feature as complete. Only callable from the ship phase. For a managed build-mode feature (one with a feature.json) this goes through the completion gate (COMP-COMPLETION-GATE): the commit is verified and tests attested when capabilities.guard is on, ONE guarded transition is ledgered, and the gate writes the completion record, feature.status COMPLETE, ROADMAP.md and the cockpit item. A refusal (bad evidence, KILLED feature, guard refused) returns 422 and writes nothing. commit_sha is required under the guard; with the guard off a commit-less completion records a no-commit completion. Fix/plan items and items with no feature.json transition as before.

commit_sha.description: Full 40-char commit SHA. Required to write a completion record.

tests_pass.description: Defaults to true when commit_sha is provided.

files_changed.description: Repo-relative paths committed in the SHA.

notes.description: One-line note for the completion record.

tools.name: start_iteration_loop
tools.description: Start a review or coverage iteration loop on a feature. Returns loop state.

maxIterations.description: Override max iterations (optional, defaults from settings)

tools.name: report_iteration_result
tools.description: Report one iteration result. Compose evaluates exit criteria and returns whether to continue.

result.description: Iteration result. Review: {clean: bool, findings: []}, Coverage: {passing: bool, failures: []}

tools.name: abort_iteration_loop
tools.description: Abort the current iteration loop early.

tools.name: assess_feature_artifacts
tools.description: Assess quality signals for all artifacts of a feature: section completeness, word count, last modified.

tools.name: scaffold_feature
tools.description: Create feature folder with template stubs for all phase artifacts. Existing files are never overwritten.

only.description: Limit to specific artifacts (e.g. ["design.md", "blueprint.md"]). Omit for all.

tools.name: approve_gate
tools.description: Resolve a pending policy gate. Outcomes: approved (proceed), revised (stay in phase), killed (abandon feature).

tools.name: get_pending_gates
tools.description: List pending policy gates. Optionally filter by item ID.

itemId.description: Filter to gates for a specific item (optional)

tools.name: add_roadmap_entry
tools.description: Register a new feature in the project. Writes feature.json and regenerates ROADMAP.md (audit-log append is best-effort). Use this instead of editing ROADMAP.md by hand.

code.description: Unique feature code (e.g. "COMP-FOO-1"). Must be uppercase A-Z, digits, dashes; cannot start or end with a dash.

description.description: One-line description for the ROADMAP cell

profile.description: Triage build profile (needs_prd/needs_architecture/etc.). Set by the plan lifecycle so build can skip fresh triage.

triageTimestamp.description: Triage cache stamp (ISO 8601). Set AFTER design.md is written so build treats triage as a cached no-op.

plannedBy.description: Originating plan session code (e.g. "PLAN-WIDGET"). Marks a plan-authored, build-ready feature.

impact.description: Estimated impact, carried from the plan/ideabox estimation step.

force.description: Bypass the pre-commit roundtrip guard (commit even if ROADMAP.md would not be a generation fixed point).

idempotency_key.description: Optional caller-provided key. Same key replays return the cached result without re-mutating.

tools.name: set_feature_status
tools.description: Flip a feature status. Updates feature.json and regenerates ROADMAP.md. Enforces a transition policy (use force: true to bypass). Appends an audit event (best-effort).

reason.description: Free-form reason persisted in the audit event

force.description: Bypass the transition policy AND the roundtrip fixed-point guard (commits even if ROADMAP.md would not be a generation fixed point). Recorded in audit.

tools.name: roadmap_diff
tools.description: Read the feature-management audit log for a window. Returns events plus derived added[] and status_changed[] arrays.

since.description: Window: shorthand like "24h"/"7d"/"30m", or an ISO date. Default 24h.

tool.description: Filter to one tool name, e.g. "set_feature_status"

tools.name: get_roadmap
tools.description: Read the current roadmap rendered from canon (feature.json) WITHOUT writing. Returns a status summary, the active/blocked convenience lists, and a staleness flag vs on-disk ROADMAP.md. Pass a status/phase filter or a limit to also get a general `rows` list (e.g. {status:"PLANNED", limit:10} for "what to work on next") — structured rows so callers never re-parse the markdown. Narrative-owned workspaces return the hand-authored file verbatim. Read-only — prefer this over reading ROADMAP.md directly.

status.description: Filter active/blocked + rows by status (comma-separated): PLANNED, IN_PROGRESS, PARTIAL, BLOCKED, COMPLETE, …

phase.description: Filter active/blocked + rows to a single phase (matched against phaseId)

format.description: "summary" (default — counts + lists, token-safe) or "markdown" (full rendered text)

check_drift.description: Compare the render against on-disk ROADMAP.md and set stale/drift (default true)

limit.description: Cap on the general `rows` list (default 50). Supplying status/phase/limit emits rows[]/rowsTotal/rowsTruncated; without any of them rows is omitted (token-safe summary). A finite value is floored and clamped to ≥ 0.

tools.name: validate_feature
tools.description: Cross-check a single feature against ROADMAP, vision-state, feature.json, folder contents, linked artifacts, and cross-references. Returns structured findings with severity (error/warning/info). FEATURE_NOT_FOUND emitted as a finding (not thrown) when the code matches strict regex but exists in no source.

external_prefixes.description: Code prefixes (e.g. ["STRAT-"]) treated as external; downgrades ORPHAN_FOLDER to info

feature_json_mode.description: Default true. Set false to skip feature.json comparisons in legacy projects.

tools.name: validate_project
tools.description: Run validate_feature for every code in vision-state, ROADMAP, and folders, plus cross-cutting checks (orphan folders, dangling cross-refs, CHANGELOG references, journal index drift) and read-only external-reference staleness (kind:"external" links + xref: roadmap citations). external:true enables network resolution of github refs (off by default — github refs then emit XREF_RESOLUTION_SKIPPED). Returns the union of all findings.

external.description: Resolve github external refs over the network (read-only). Default false: github refs degrade to XREF_RESOLUTION_SKIPPED.

fix.description: COMP-MCP-VALIDATE-2: reconcile mechanical drift. Returns a fix plan under `reconcile` (dry-run unless apply:true). Local-provider only.

apply.description: With fix:true, write the fixes and re-validate. Default false (dry-run plan only).

fix_classes.description: Override the enabled fix classes: dangling_link, invalid_link_kind, status_fj_vision, partial_age, roadmap_status_rewrite, invalid_link_kind_repair. Default: the non-destructive set.

tools.name: roadmap_graph
tools.description: COMP-ROADMAP-GRAPH-1: generate a self-contained roadmap dependency-graph HTML from feature.json status/phase + per-feature deps.yaml edges + display frontmatter. Drops COMPLETE/SUPERSEDED/KILLED nodes; refuses (DANGLING_EDGE) when any edge points at an unknown feature. Deterministic/idempotent. Returns a small summary (path + counts + warnings), never the HTML body.

project.description: Project root path. Default: current workspace.

out.description: Output HTML path (relative to project root unless absolute). Default: compose.json#roadmap_graph.out or roadmap-graph.html.

tools.name: roadmap_graph_check
tools.description: COMP-ROADMAP-GRAPH-1: render the roadmap graph in-memory and diff against the on-disk HTML without writing. Returns { matches, exists, diffSummary, counts, warnings }. matches:false means the file is stale/missing — run roadmap_graph. Raises DANGLING_EDGE on a bad edge.

project.description: Project root path. Default: current workspace.

out.description: Output HTML path to compare against. Default: compose.json#roadmap_graph.out or roadmap-graph.html.

tools.name: roadmap_xref_push
tools.description: COMP-ROADMAP-XREF-PUSH: write external trackers to match feature.json declared `expect=`/`expect_labels` intent or lifecycle-derived intent (`derive_expect: true`; GitHub/Forgejo). DRY-RUN by default — returns {pushed, skipped, unchanged, scanned} describing what WOULD change. Only links with `push: true` are eligible. apply:true performs the writes: GitHub issue open/closed + additive labels (never removes; PR-backed refs skipped); Forgejo issue state + additive labels through independent operations, with partial-success rows reporting {statePushed, labelsPushed, errors[]}; and local refs via the sibling repo's own setFeatureStatus. Resolution failures are skipped; GitHub write failures and local disallowed transitions also skip, while successful Forgejo operations remain reported if another operation fails. Returns a small summary, never a large body.

project.description: Project root path. Default: current workspace.

apply.description: Perform the writes. Default false (dry-run — report only).

tools.name: propose_followup
tools.description: File a follow-up feature against a parent. Auto-numbers the next code in the parent's namespace (parent_code-N), adds the ROADMAP row, links surfaced_by from new → parent, and scaffolds design.md with a "## Why" rationale block. Idempotent on (parent_code, idempotency_key); resumes across partial failures via an inflight ledger.

parent_code.description: Parent feature code (e.g. "COMP-MCP-MIGRATION"). Must exist; must not be KILLED/SUPERSEDED.

description.description: One-line description for the ROADMAP cell.

rationale.description: Why this follow-up exists. Persisted as a "## Why" block in the new design.md and in the audit event.

phase.description: Phase heading. Defaults to the parent's phase if omitted.

idempotency_key.description: Optional retry-safety key. Without it, repeated calls allocate new codes.

tools.name: link_artifact
tools.description: Register a non-canonical artifact (snapshot, journal entry, finding, etc.) on a feature. Canonical artifacts (design.md, plan.md, …) inside the feature folder are auto-discovered and rejected here. Stores in feature.json artifacts[]; dedups on (type, path); appends an audit event (best-effort).

path.description: Repo-relative path. Must exist; cannot contain ".." after normalization.

force.description: Overwrite an existing entry with the same (type, path)

tools.name: link_features
tools.description: Register a typed cross-feature relationship. Two shapes: (1) SAME-PROJECT — kind ∈ surfaced_by|blocks|depends_on|follow_up|supersedes|related, requires to_code; self-links rejected; dedups on (kind,to_code). (2) EXTERNAL (kind:"external") — a cross-project pointer, NOT a same-project link: requires provider; four resolvable sub-shapes — github or forgejo (repo "owner/name" + integer issue), local (repo token + to_code), url (url); plus reserved url-class providers jira|linear|notion|obsidian (parse-valid, require url, NOT resolved in v1). External dedups on (kind=external, provider, repo, issue|to_code|url). Stores on the source feature; query inverse via get_feature_links(direction:"incoming").

to_code.description: Same-project: target feature code (required unless kind:"external"). External local: the cited feature code. Need not exist yet.

provider.description: Required when kind:"external". Resolvable: github|forgejo|local|url. Reserved url-class (require url, not resolved in v1): jira|linear|notion|obsidian.

repo.description: External github/forgejo: "owner/name". External local: workspace-relative repo token.

expect.description: Optional expected state. github/forgejo: open|closed. local: a status token. url-class: recorded, never resolved.

push.description: Opt this external link into roadmap_xref_push. Default false.

expect_labels.description: Optional labels to add without removing existing labels. Supported by github and forgejo links.

derive_expect.description: For github/forgejo, derive open|closed from the owning feature status at validation and push time instead of storing expect.

tools.name: get_feature_artifacts
tools.description: Read both canonical (auto-discovered: design.md, plan.md, …) and linked (snapshots, journals, findings) artifacts for a feature in one call. Each linked entry includes a current existence check.

tools.name: get_feature_links
tools.description: Read outgoing and/or incoming feature links. Default returns both directions; filter by kind if needed.

tools.name: add_changelog_entry
tools.description: Insert (or replace, with force: true) a typed entry in compose/CHANGELOG.md. Idempotent on (date_or_version, code) at storage level; optional caller-supplied idempotency_key for retry safety. Audit-log append is best-effort. Use this instead of editing CHANGELOG.md by hand.

code.description: Feature code (e.g. "COMP-FOO-1"). Uppercase A-Z, digits, dashes; cannot start or end with a dash.

summary.description: One-line summary; renders as the "— summary" tail of the entry header.

body.description: Free paragraphs between header and labeled subsections.

sections.description: Optional labeled subsections; emitted in fixed order Added → Changed → Fixed → Snapshot.

force.description: If true and an entry with the same (date_or_version, code) exists, replace it in place.

idempotency_key.description: Optional caller-supplied key. Same key replays return the cached result without re-mutating.

tools.name: get_changelog_entries
tools.description: Read parsed entries from compose/CHANGELOG.md. Filter by code (exact) or since (shorthand "24h"/"7d"/"30m" or ISO date — date-only; version surfaces always pass through).

since.description: Window: shorthand like "24h"/"7d"/"30m" or ISO date. Date-only filter; version surfaces are always returned.

tools.name: write_journal_entry
tools.description: Write a typed entry to compose/docs/journal/ with auto-numbered global session and inserted index row. Idempotent on (date, slug) at storage level; optional caller idempotency_key for retry safety. Audit-log append is best-effort.

slug.description: Kebab-case slug for the filename, e.g. "mcp-journal-writer".

summary_for_index.description: Single-line summary for the README index row. No newlines, no "|".

feature_code.description: Optional feature code stamped in entry frontmatter.

force.description: If true and an entry with the same (date, slug) exists, overwrite in place.

idempotency_key.description: Optional caller-supplied key. Same key replays return the cached result without re-mutating.

tools.name: get_journal_entries
tools.description: Read parsed entries from compose/docs/journal/. Filter by feature_code (exact), session (exact), or since (shorthand "24h"/"7d"/"30m" or ISO date).

tools.name: backfill_completion
tools.description: Reconstruct a completion through the running Compose server from historical evidence. With no configured guard.testCommand, tests_pass must be explicitly true. Each occurrence must cite either a verified commit SHA or a repo-relative file already inside the repository. This is HTTP delegation like complete_feature, so the Compose server must be running.

tools.name: record_completion
tools.description: Record a completion bound to a commit SHA — THROUGH the completion gate (COMP-COMPLETION-GATE): under capabilities.guard the commit is server-verified and tests attested (no silent default), ONE guarded transition is ledgered, then the gate writes completions[], status COMPLETE, ROADMAP.md, the cockpit item and the audit event. A refusal (bad evidence, KILLED/SUPERSEDED feature, guard refused/unreachable) errors with COMPLETION_REFUSED and writes NOTHING. Projection failures (ROADMAP/vision) return success with partial:true + failures[]. set_status:false records evidence only (no status change, no guard transition). Idempotent on (feature_code, commit_sha).

commit_sha.description: Full 40-char hex SHA (Decision 9). Short prefixes are rejected before any guard write. Stored lowercase; commit_sha_short is derived for display only.

set_status.description: Default true. When true, flips status to COMPLETE via set_feature_status.

force.description: If true and a record with the same (feature_code, commit_sha) exists, replace it in place.

tools.name: get_completions
tools.description: Read completion records from feature.json files. Filter by feature_code (exact), commit_sha (short or full prefix), or since (shorthand or ISO date).

tools.name: write_checkpoint
tools.description: COMP-RESUME: write a durable build checkpoint anchored to a deterministic environment fingerprint. Omit `soft` for a cheap anchor checkpoint — the response then includes a `scribePrompt` you can answer (returning {goal,nextStep,risks} anchored to the fingerprint) and re-submit as `soft` for a narrative checkpoint. Pass `soft` directly to skip that. Returns {checkpoint, scribePrompt}. Direct-to-disk (works when the server is down).

phase.description: Lifecycle phase label; falls back to feature.json then "unknown".

soft.description: Narrative intent; omit for an anchor checkpoint. Every factual claim should reference a fingerprint anchor.

tools.name: compose_resume
tools.description: COMP-RESUME: reconcile a build against ground-truth environment state and return the resume decision. Rebuilds derived state, classifies drift (clean/advanced/diverged), and returns action resume|needs-sync|gate. On needs-sync the caller runs the reconciliation agent with the returned prompt. Requires the Compose server (reconciles live lifecycle state).

tools.name: judgment_position_create
tools.description: Create a judgment position revision (new chain, update, supersession via supersedes, or tombstone via retracted). ASSERT grounding requires an elicitation block. Provenance is writer-stamped.

claims.description: Claims: {id, text, grounding EXT|INT|ASSERT|DERIVED|AGENT, supports[], elicitation?}.

tools.name: judgment_position_amend
tools.description: Scoped amendment (P6): new revision changing ONE claim's grounding and/or the conviction block. Anything else is supersession via judgment_position_create.

elicitation.description: Required if new grounding is ASSERT.

tools.name: judgment_joint_add
tools.description: Add a judgment joint (born open). Both branches and a coarse cost bucket are required; EXT/STRADDLE method packages may be attached now or at dispose time.

ext.description: EXT package: {sharpened_question, bar, falsifier} or {judgment_dispatch: true, reason}.

tools.name: judgment_transition
tools.description: Joint state machine (edge→artifact table enforced; Stratum-guarded where capabilities.guard). Provide the target state plus its required artifact (resolution/dissolution/reopen/redispose), and/or a rank change (atomic rank ledger event).

redispose.description: {new_resolve_by, ext?, straddle?} (retry inconclusive with a different method)

ext.description: EXT package attached at dispose time.

tools.name: judgment_ledger_append
tools.description: Append a judgment ledger event (kind-specific required fields enforced: commit-decide needs trigger+open_joints+prediction; postmortem needs recall_verdict+attribution and grades prediction_ref; override needs reason). Commit/CONSTRUCT events spawn prediction records.

trigger.description: On decide: earned|forced|exhausted (marks a commit-moment decide).

disposition.description: Method disposed with; CONSTRUCT requires prediction.

rests_on.description: On commit-moment decide: goal clause refs (goal:v<N>#c<N>) the commit rests on; resolved through the effective goal chain.

tools.name: judgment_person_write
tools.description: Write person canon by op. create adds a person; open_field supports create, fill, and reopen; edge/load_link support create and remove; correct supports divergence pair/clear. Provenance is writer-stamped.

via.description: Source attribution for a secondhand fact; not provenance.

to.description: edge create branch target person slug.

tools.name: judgment_situation_write
tools.description: Write situation-entity canon by op. create adds an entity; owed supports create, give, and reopen; load_link supports create and remove. Provenance is writer-stamped.

via.description: Source attribution for a secondhand fact; not provenance.

tools.name: judgment_goal_write
tools.description: Write goal canon by op. Ordinary cuts require elicited clauses, provocation, and owner ratification. Every non-migrate op is migration-locked while a live legacy objective requires migration; migrate is the one-shot, fail-closed cutover that lifts the lock and takes no payload. joint_link/load_link support create and remove. Provenance and intents are writer-owned.

clauses.description: cut: {text, channel, elicitation, secondhand source attribution?}[]

tools.name: get_judgment_state
tools.description: Judgment canon snapshot: positions (derived status), joints, under-test, open predictions, recent ledger. Replays pending judgment intents first.

tools.name: get_judgment_trace
tools.description: Causal ancestry of one judgment position: every revision in order, what it superseded (walked recursively), and what superseded it. Read-only; answers "what did we believe when we made that call", which get_judgment_state cannot (it returns latest-only).
